programme.desc: Dora and Boots help Coco the Cocodrilo get home before bedtime so he can give his loose tooth to Ratoncito Perez. // Dora and Boots help track down the Bunny Boyz after Boots accidentally flings them into the rainforest before a show.

programme.desc: Barbapapa and Lolita spotted a flying saucer approaching their house. // The Barbapapa have taken off aboard Bababam in the hope of discovering the planet of Baby Big Feet.

programme.title: E14 - Josephine Pra (Paris)/Mourad Merzouki And Oussama Elyousfi (Paris And Borde
programme.desc: Richard Orlinski explores contemporary francophone dance through three journeys. Josephine Pra, a classical and neoclassical dancer, introduces him to the fundamentals and evolutions of her art. At the 104 in Paris, they experiment with the fusion of technical rigor and expressive freedom. For his part, Mourad Merzouki, a major figure in contemporary hip-hop, boldly blends dance, circus and martial arts in engaged creations, carried by a multicultural troupe. Oussama Elyousfi, a dancer with the Kaefig company directed by the Lyon-based choreographer, bears witness to this encounter between urban cultures and artistic institutions.

E6 - Turf Games
programme.desc: As the team completes the three brutal events scheduled in 48 hours, Adam plans a surprise return to the East Coast with a Turf Games event in Sydney.

programme.title: E3 - Silencing Terry
programme.desc: Terry wants to demonstrate how Hollywood has used different objects to silence a gunshot, so he and Larry take to the range to see which one is the most qualified to act as a “silencer.” Terry also has a sit-down with Joey Zasa himself from Godfather 3 (Joe Mantegna) to discuss what he thinks of Hollywood’s adaptation of the silencer.

programme.title: E4 - Meet The Smiths
programme.desc: Terry finally gets to compare himself to Brad Pitt!! Terry and Larry test 3 scenes from the action film Mr. and Mrs. Smith. Can a refrigerator or elevator door protect our heroes? Also, can you ignite a gas line with just a bullet? Larry may not look as stunning as Angelina Jolie, but he will help Terry find out the answers.

programme.title: E1 - Scoters and the Salton Sea
programme.desc: Scott hits the waters of California in search of the ducks...and duck waters less hunted. Join the surf scoter hunt on the San Francisco Bay, then head south to an area Scott Leysath refers to as ''The Hills Have Eyes.'' The Salton Sea, just a couple hours east of Los Angeles, has a creep factor of 11, and the duck hunting is like no other place he has hunted.

programme.title: E10 - Vietnam
programme.desc: Off to Vietnam next, Rooftop and Catfish embark on what may be their most dangerous visit yet. The BMX bikers start their journey relatively tame with a shot of snake blood. However, things quickly escalate from there with the most intense game of frogger they’ve ever played in the Vietnamese streets. From a hospital visit and racing through the Vietcong tunnels to trying fertilized baby bird eggs and relaxing in a boiling hot spring, nothing can prepare the duo for the ending of their trip heading to the demilitarized zone to detonate bombs. After this trip to Vietnam, what more heart-racing adventures and Rooftop and Catfish possibly find?

programme.title: E1 - Lionfish
programme.desc: The white sand beaches and emerald green waters of Destin, Florida are the setting for the 'World's Luckiest Fishing Villages.' Beneath the water's surface, it's a different story...one of the most formidable species, the lionfish, has been wreaking havoc on the local ecosystem for decades. The ecological advantage of the lionfish is its venomous spikes, used to corner prey and protect itself from predators, and giving it an advantage over native fish. Luckily, local conservationists and fishing captains discovered years ago that lionfish are as tasty as they are dangerous. Yia joins local biologist Alex Fogg as he works to mitigate the lionfish's damage by harvesting them one buttery, flaky bite at a time.

programme.title: E2 - Feral Hogs
programme.desc: The feral hog is one of the most formidable species on the planet. Possessing a unique combination of high reproductive capacity, size, and adaptability, the feral hog absolutely decimates entire ecosystems. With pork chops on his mind, Yia travels to the Florida/Alabama border to join Jennifer Bearden and Zack Franks who are doing their part to help control the rampant feral hog population menacing Florida.

programme.title: E1 - Ho Chi Minh City
programme.desc: Home to more than 5 million motorbikes, Ho Chi Minh City is a veritable river of two-wheelers where drivers carry everything from windows and doors to entire families on their scooters.

programme.title: E1 - South Australia
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.desc: As the team completes the three brutal events scheduled in 48 hours, Adam plans a surprise return to the East Coast with a Turf Games event in Sydney.

programme.title: E3 - Silencing Terry
programme.desc: Terry wants to demonstrate how Hollywood has used different objects to silence a gunshot, so he and Larry take to the range to see which one is the most qualified to act as a “silencer.” Terry also has a sit-down with Joey Zasa himself from Godfather 3 (Joe Mantegna) to discuss what he thinks of Hollywood’s adaptation of the silencer.

programme.title: E4 - Meet The Smiths
programme.desc: Terry finally gets to compare himself to Brad Pitt!! Terry and Larry test 3 scenes from the action film Mr. and Mrs. Smith. Can a refrigerator or elevator door protect our heroes? Also, can you ignite a gas line with just a bullet? Larry may not look as stunning as Angelina Jolie, but he will help Terry find out the answers.

programme.title: E1 - Scoters and the Salton Sea
programme.desc: Scott hits the waters of California in search of the ducks...and duck waters less hunted. Join the surf scoter hunt on the San Francisco Bay, then head south to an area Scott Leysath refers to as ''The Hills Have Eyes.'' The Salton Sea, just a couple hours east of Los Angeles, has a creep factor of 11, and the duck hunting is like no other place he has hunted.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing met Bonnie, a secret lover of a gang and is bombed for revenge. Only his mouth, brain and penis can still function. The doctor proposed the 'Sixty Million Dollar Man' plan...

programme.title: Dream Of Desire
programme.desc: Fat Chiu and Frankie live together on a temporary basis. During their stay at home, they spend time with one of the home-mate Kwan and consequently build up very close relationship. Sally, who is Frankie's girlfriend, is deeply in romance with Frankie. However, when Pauline, a billionaire turns up, Frankie is crazily attracted by her. He decides to give up Sally. On the other hand, Fat Chiu immediately proceeds his plan and shows his care and love to Sally. Although Sally is so touched of the sincerity of Fat Chiu and accepts his offer, she knows she still loves Frankie. Kwan opines that Sally is damaging female dignity. Likewise, Kwan also disgraces Frankie as he sacrifices both his lover and friendship, simply because of his personal desire...

programme.title: Fruit Punch
programme.desc: Five young men threw themselves with heart and soul into the work force. They have different approaches and different life styles. Ah Kit is the hardworking investment broker. He is so busy making money. Ah Chi is a postman believing in fung shui. Ah Hark is an apprentice in his family jewelry shop and Ah Wai failed in public exam. Ah Ming is the most unconventional of the five. Working in a Japanese restaurant. The five start a laundry shop which soon folds. Next, they try something new to save their business. Ah Ming leads a carefree life which dismays his girl, Yoko. Ah Hark's girlfriend Cat will move to Australia and leave him soon. Ah Ming and Ah Hark are going to lose their girlfriends. The five new generation are going their own ways...

programme.title: Casino Raider 2
programme.desc: Though persuaded by his brother, Chicken Wing, Kit refused to gamble again. However, Tommy keeps on harassing them, Kit finally decided to take revenge...

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 故事講述在1987年被囚禁的兩名男女之間奇怪而美麗的時間旅行，一個尋找過去連環殺人真相的男人和一個想要阻止爸爸媽媽結婚的女人相互意識到目標連接在一起的故事。​

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 對情感持絕對懷疑的「尹菲雅」，因心理創傷無法與人相處超過一小時。當她遇見感性卻陷入創作瓶頸的頂尖作家「韓善浩」，兩人因一款AI戀愛程式產生交集。她相信數據能篩選完美伴侶，他卻在虛擬對話中看見她傷痕下的真實。這段由演算法開始的相遇，，最終收穫愛情的故事。

E29
programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。

programme.title: E23
programme.desc: 《今生有你》根據匪我思存的小説《愛你是最好的時光》改編，講述了心外科醫生聶宇晟與曾經的戀人、單親媽媽談靜攜手面對命運，最終迎來幸福人生的故事。

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: In a moment of irresponsible negligence, sharp-tongued barrister Adrian Lam mishandles a child abuse case and indirectly sentences the innocent Jolene Tsang to prison for 17 years. Falling from disgrace, Adrian decides to serve the public and defend the commoners, until an unlikely opportunity for appeal surfaces. Determined to right his wrong, Adrian gathers former partners Evelyn Fong and Prince to free Jolene, but that would mean fighting against the tycoons, Victoria and Desmond Chung, who also have barrister James Tung as their private consultant. With pressure from media and police, and facing tough cross examination from prosecutor Kam Yuen Shan in court, how will Adrian uphold justice and punish the true culprit?

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: The world is under attack from an “Love virus”? Taek-seon is a translator who always feels tired, unmotivated and uninterested in romance. One day, Taek-seon has a disastrous blind date with Su-pil, a born single medical researcher who proposes on their first meeting. After the date they met, the world is suddenly enveloped in atmosphere of love... Taek-seon found herself laughing for no reason and searching for a beautiful dress, everything looks cute, even a daily promotional text from her old classmate Yeon-woo. However, Taek-seon knew that she had been infected with 100% fatality rate deadly virus -- Toxo Virus. She meets Dr. Lee Gyun, the only researcher who can create the antiviral medicine and she realizes that all these romantic feelings are symptoms of virus. Thus, her unexpected journey begins...

programme.title: The Rising Star -Kay Choi
programme.desc: A character with unique accent unexpectedly made this previously unknown actress an overnight sensation! In this episode, Kay Choi, who played Francesca in the film “Night King,” is invited to talk about how she seized the audition opportunity, added flair to the character with her creativity, and share her inner struggles of portraying a club girl on screen. As she approaches thirty and her career begins to take off, how will she face the society's definition toward women at her age, and what are her expectations for the future?
